6.179 rsWrongNumberOfMatrixColumns
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsWrongNumberOfMatrixColumns is a critical error that will occur when a Matrix contains a different
number of MatrixColumn elements than the number of StaticColumn elements. If the matrix contains
no StaticColumn elements, the matrix will contain exactly one MatrixColumn element.
